nextStoryContext: readWorkerOutcome({ prdPath, handoffPath, capturedPaneText, readFile }) lives in src/supervisor/result.ts. Returns { kind: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'blocked' | 'unknown', storyId: string | undefined, detail: string }. It is a pure function with no I/O: all file reading is injected via FileReader = (path: string) => string | null. Three-way cross-check (sentinel in pane text + handoff.json lastCompletedStory.id + prd.json passes:true) is the architectural invariant for a 'pass' outcome. The supervisor (US-006/US-007) can import this and call it after a worker pane finishes (after the tmux wait-for unblocks or times out) to determine what to do next.
